findings.evidence: docs/decisions/0004-main-advance-revalidation.md line 81: '| 2026-10-29 | quick-task-behind-mergeable-spec, BR-774 (in progress) | ... | Spec catch-up, no behavior change. |'. docs/decisions/README.md says to change a decision by creating a new record, not by editing the old one.
findings.summary: DEC-0004 is marked Current and lists an attempt as '(in progress)' with no PR link. The record contract says earlier records are preserved and changed only by a superseding record, so nothing is set up to update that row once the work lands. The record then keeps pointing at unfinished work.

findings.evidence: proposal.md 'Why' names eight changes 'plus BR-774 and BR-777'. The DEC-0004 'Attempts' table has 12 rows.
findings.summary: The proposal says the problem was attacked 'at least eight' times. Its own list, together with the BR-774 and BR-777 additions, names ten or more attempts. DEC-0004's table has eleven completed or in-progress rows. The count and the enumeration disagree, which weakens the claim that the history is complete.
